Hulk attacks Rhino for 3 first (onto the Suit or Rhino), before my hero-only attack events after changing to Iron Man.

Exhaust Arc Reactor to ready Iron Man (Tony's exhaustion carried over), giving a basic power this turn: I will thwart the main scheme to lower the threat from 5.

Pay Uppercut with Stark Tower, Mockingbird and Combat Training, keeping Tigra, War Machine and Supersonic Punch.
